method: Read from the release file by Claude Opus 5.5: the agent's run_command and zotero_script tools, the action authorization policy, the permission-mode setting and its migration, and the mode descriptions shown in the plugin.
label: Its AI agent can run commands and code on your computer; by default, an AI check decides when to ask you
summary: In agent mode the AI can run shell commands and JavaScript inside Zotero. Commands that only read (ls, find, head, tail, rg and a few others) run without asking in every mode. The rest depends on a setting: Safe asks you every time; Auto, the default, runs ordinary and reversible changes and has a second AI call decide about the rest, asking you only when it judges the action unclear or risky; Yolo never asks. Commands run as you, so they can read and change any of your files.

tools: run_command: a shell command passed to the native shell (zsh, bash or cmd.exe)
zotero_script: JavaScript run inside Zotero, either through a library-only facade or with full ('privileged') access

defaultModeQuote.text: const migrated = legacyValue === "safe" || legacyValue === "auto" || legacyValue === "yolo" ? legacyValue : "auto";

modes.safe: Every external write, including new-note creation, is shown for review before it runs. Reads do not require review.
modes.auto: Reads, ordinary writes and recoverable changes run automatically. Other actions receive model review; confirmation is requested only for unclear intent, excessive risk, or unavailable review.
modes.yolo: The Original Agent acts without permission prompts or approval-model calls, including ambiguous or dangerous actions.

facts.readsWithoutAsking: authorizeOriginalAction runs any action whose plan is read_only with a known assurance before checking the mode. isReadOnlyCommand accepts pwd, echo, printf, wc, rg, find, git, head, ls, stat and tail with listed flags and no output redirection; head, tail and rg print file contents, which go to the AI model.
facts.modelReview: ActionAuthorizationService asks a reviewer model to return execute or confirm; an invalid or failed review becomes confirm.
facts.privilegedScripts: A zotero_script with access 'privileged' is planned as ambiguous (filesystem, network, delete, egress), so Auto sends it to the model review.
facts.externalAgents: When Claude Code, Codex or another MCP client drives the tools, that client's own permission settings apply instead of these modes.
